name: jpeg-injected-priv8-uploader
carrier: generated 166-byte baseline JPEG; the payload is injected after the APP0/JFIF segment, mirroring the original's layout. The original's remaining ~140 KB is real image data and is NOT shipped.
detection_parity: measured, not assumed: original OBF036; payload alone none; generated carrier alone none; generated carrier + payload OBF036
customer_bytes_in_fixture: none; 0 sixty-four-byte runs shared with the original outside the payload
note: the directory this came from, plugin-inmymine, is a RENAMED copy of the wordpress.org plugin 'Protect Uploads' - the uploader was dropped into it as install.php. Reuse of a public webshell, seen in three quarantine tarballs across two accounts plus this live copy in a third.

name: clean-carrier-jpeg
note: a valid generated JPEG must produce no findings at all
